text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Kikuka Sho paddock, Mejiro Ardan 
felt an unprecedented sense of pressure. 
Its source was none other than Super 
Creek, who wore a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan rejoiced at crossing paths 
with a new, formidable rival. Yaeno Muteki 
felt the exact same way, and both stepped 
onto the track knowing a fierce battle 
awaited them.
